title: FNAF 4 Jumpscare
blurb: By the fourth game the horror had moved out of the pizzeria entirely and into a child's bedroom, where the only mechanic left was standing at a door and listening. Get it wrong and the Nightmare animatronics deliver this: closer, louder and considerably meaner than anything in the first three games, with no security desk between you and it. Most of the fandom rates it the harshest scream in the series, and the design logic is obvious — you spent the whole night holding your breath, so the payoff had to be unbearable. Sleep is cancelled.
origin: The nightmare-animatronic jumpscare from Five Nights at Freddy's 4.
